lines.en: label library50:
scene romancenovels1
I make my way over to the library hoping to find Futaba but, instead, am greeted by a lone folder occupying the space she normally sits at.
lines.zh: 我走到图书馆，希望能找到 Futaba，可迎接我的只有一个孤零零的文件夹，占着她平时坐的位置。

lines.en: And while I’m sure that sparking up a conversation with it wouldn’t be the {i}first{/i} time I’ve gotten locked in a discussion with an inanimate object, it’s not really something I typically {i}seek out.{/i}
lines.zh: 虽然我敢说，跟它搭上话绝不是我{i}第一次{/i}和一件无生命的物体陷入长谈，但这确实不是我通常会{i}主动追求{/i}的事。

lines.en: Either way, it’s not like I have anything else going on today- so I might as well wait around until Futaba inevitably returns to reclaim her folder.
lines.zh: 无论如何，反正我今天也没别的事——不如就在这儿等着，Futaba 迟早会回来取她的文件夹。

lines.en: scene romancenovels2
When I take a step closer, I notice a very specific and extremely suspicious warning scribbled along the bottom of a piece of paper.
lines.zh: 走近一步后，我注意到一张纸的底部潦草地写着一条非常特别、也非常可疑的警告。

lines.en: It’s the type of warning that essentially beckons a person to do the opposite of whatever is written- much like a “keep off grass” sign but with more...pinstripes.
lines.zh: 这是那种本质上在招手让人反着来的警告——很像「请勿践踏草坪」的牌子，只不过多了些……细条纹。

lines.en: Obviously, I’m going to move the folder. Not just because I’m being told {i}not to,{/i} but because I have no idea what would compel someone to provide a warning like that in the first place.
lines.zh: 显然，我要把文件夹挪开。不光是因为有人告诉我{i}别动{/i}，还因为我完全想不通，究竟是什么促使一个人一开始就写下这样的警告。

lines.en: scene romancenovels3
Today is weird.
lines.zh: 今天很怪。

lines.en: I stare at the back of Futaba’s head for a moment or two, expecting her to realize I’m here and scold me for once again disregarding easily-followed rules.
lines.zh: 我盯着 Futaba 的后脑勺看了一会儿，等着她发现我在这儿，然后像往常一样训我一顿，怪我又无视了那些很容易遵守的规则。

lines.en: But, as she tends to do, she remains focused on what’s in front of her, not paying any mind to the fact that I have crumbled the barrier between us.
lines.zh: 可她一如既往地专注在面前的东西上，丝毫不在意我已经推倒了我们之间那道屏障。

lines.en: Either that or she’s caught in a daydream again but, based on the precedent set by all of the {i}other{/i} times she’s daydreamt, I don’t really think she’d do that on the {i}floor.{/i}
lines.zh: 要么就是她又在做白日梦了，不过根据她{i}以往{/i}做白日梦的先例，我觉得她应该不会在{i}地板{/i}上做那种事。

lines.en: Maybe she’s just dead?
lines.zh: 也许她只是死了？

lines.en: Her head isn’t moving at all. Maybe some angry library-goer decapitated her and left her head on a spike behind a folder and just hoped that someone a little better at following rules would show up in my place?
lines.zh: 她的头一动不动。也许是哪个愤怒的读者把她斩了首，把她的头插在尖桩上、藏在文件夹后面，只盼着会来一个比我更守规矩的人？

lines.en: Or she’s just reading.
lines.zh: 或者她只是在看书。

lines.en: scene romancenovels4
Yeah, I’m pretty sure she’s just reading.
lines.zh: 嗯，我很确定她只是在看书。

lines.en: Why she’s doing that down there when there are plenty of chairs around, I’m not sure. But it is my mission at this point in time to find out or her folder will have died for nothing.
lines.zh: 周围明明有一堆椅子，她却偏要在那下面看，我不明白。不过此时此刻，我的使命就是搞清楚——否则她的文件夹就白死了。

lines.en: : Fu-
lines.zh: : Fu——

lines.en: A hushed and...suspiciously aroused sigh escapes her lips as I look down on her in a way much different from how things normally are when I hear her emit noises like that.
lines.zh: 一声压抑的、而且……可疑地带着情欲的叹息从她唇间溢出，我低头看着她，和我平时听到她发出这种声音时的情形大不相同。

lines.en: But while I’d love to stick around and hear her {i}continue{/i} to make these noises, I am stricken with an intense bout of jealousy in knowing that she is getting just as aroused for {i}paper{/i} as she does for me.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想留下来{i}继续{/i}听她发出这些声音，但一想到她对着一堆{i}纸{/i}也能和我让她时一样兴奋，我就被一阵强烈的嫉妒击中了。

lines.en: : Okay. That’s enough.
lines.zh: : 好了。够了。

lines.en: scene romancenovels5
: {i}Mnh...it’s almost like...I can hear him...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯……简直就像……我能听见他一样……{/i}

lines.en: : You can. I’m right behind you and capable of satisfying you in ways much greater than a rectangle comprised of slaughtered trees.
lines.zh: : 你确实能。我就在你身后，而且能满足你的方式，远比一堆被屠杀的树做成的长方形厉害得多。

lines.en: scene romancenovels6
: Did you...
: There was a...a sign...
lines.zh: : 那儿有……有个牌子……

lines.en: : Yeah. I took it down because I was curious about what one measly little folder could possibly conceal. Little did I know it was just a horny librarian.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我把它拿下来了，因为我好奇区区一个文件夹到底能藏住什么。谁知道那后面只是个发情的图书管理员。

lines.en: scene romancenovels7
: I’m...I’m not...
lines.zh: : 我……我不是……

lines.en: : I’m just...on my lunch break right now...
lines.zh: : 我只是……现在是午休时间……

lines.en: : Cool. Spend it with me and tell me about whatever weird fantasy book is getting you all riled up in the middle of a public forum.
lines.zh: : 酷。那就陪我过，跟我讲讲是什么奇怪的奇幻书，让你在大庭广众之下这么来劲。

lines.en: scene romancenovels8
: Can I...at least finish this chapter? And can you maybe put the folder back up? I didn’t want anyone watching me while I...you know...
lines.zh: : 我……至少能先把这章看完吗？你能不能把文件夹放回去？我不想有人看着我……你知道的……

lines.en: : Masturbate?
lines.zh: : 自慰？

: Read! I’m not going to masturbate in a library!
lines.zh: : 看书！我才不会在图书馆里自慰！

lines.en: : Well, you could’ve fooled me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你差点就骗过我了。

lines.en: scene black
Disregarding Futaba’s request to leave her alone until she finishes the next chapter of her book, I move to the opposite side of the counter and take a seat beside her.
lines.zh: 我不理会 Futaba 让她等自己看完下一章的请求，绕到柜台另一侧，在她身边坐下。

lines.en: scene romancenovels10
I also steal her book because I am stronger than her and curious about just what she’d choose to read over spending time with me.
lines.zh: 我还顺走了她的书，因为我比她强壮，也好奇她究竟宁愿看什么，也不愿陪我。

lines.en: : H-Hey! Give that back! I wasn’t done with that yet!
lines.zh: : 喂——喂！还给我！我还没看完呢！

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sensei！

lines.en: : I...would like my book back, please!
lines.zh: : 我……想把书要回来，拜托！

lines.en: : Huh.
: I didn’t think you read this kind of stuff, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 我没想到你会看这种东西，Futaba。

lines.en: scene romancenovels11
: Oh my God...
lines.zh: : 天哪……

lines.en: : I guess I can see why you were getting so into it, though. It’s {i}very{/i} descriptive.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概能理解你为什么看得这么入迷了。写得{i}非常{/i}露骨。

lines.en: : I always kind of figured Nodoka was the erotica girl, though.
lines.zh: : 我一直以为 Nodoka 才是那个看色情小说的。

lines.en: scene romancenovels12
: It’s not {i}just{/i} erotica, Sensei! There are just...erotic scenes in it. Call it a romance novel! It makes me feel less...lewd!
lines.zh: : 这可不{i}只是{/i}色情小说，Sensei！只是……里面有色情的场面。叫它言情小说！这样我就没那么……下流了！

lines.en: : If that’s what you want, sure. Is this really something you should be reading while on duty, though?
lines.zh: : 你高兴就好。不过你值班的时候真该看这种东西吗？

lines.en: : I was on my break!
lines.zh: : 我在休息！

lines.en: : It’s like 10:30 already. You never take breaks around this time.
lines.zh: : 已经十点半了。你平常这个时间从不休息。

lines.en: scene romancenovels13
: It’s 10:30 already?
lines.zh: : 已经十点半了？

lines.en: : Yeah...How long have you been reading this?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你看了多久了？

lines.en: : I don’t want to talk about it.
lines.zh: : 我不想谈这个。

lines.en: : Futaba-
lines.zh: : Futaba——

lines.en: scene romancenovels14
: I have a problem, okay?! I borrowed a romance novel from Nodoka and ever since, I can’t stop reading them! I’m losing sleep! I didn’t even eat dinner last night!
lines.zh: : 我上瘾了，行了吧？！我从 Nodoka 那儿借了一本言情小说，从那以后我就停不下来了！我连觉都不睡了！昨晚连晚饭都没吃！

lines.en: : I’m kind of upset that you never became this addicted to me.
lines.zh: : 我有点难过，你从来没对我上瘾到这个程度。

lines.en: scene romancenovels15
: It’s easier in books since...I’m able to separate myself from everything. When things happen in real life and I remember that I’m a part of it, I just...
lines.zh: : 书里比较容易，因为……我能把自己从一切中抽离出来。当事情发生在现实里，而我记起自己也是其中一部分时，我就……

lines.en: : It’s harder for me to enjoy things like that.
lines.zh: : 我就很难享受那种事了。

lines.en: : This just seems like a lot of effort to go to when outlets like porn exist.
lines.zh: : 既然有黄片这种发泄渠道，这么做未免太费劲了吧。

lines.en: : I’ve never really...liked porn. It’s always made me feel kind of weird. Plus, it’s not like I could even watch it in the library if I wanted to.
lines.zh: : 我从来都不太……喜欢黄片。它总让我觉得有点怪。再说了，就算我想看，也没法在图书馆里看啊。

lines.en: : Besides...romance novels aren’t {i}just{/i} sex, you know. They have stories just like any other book. There’s just an additional...window into intimacy in them that many of the other stories I read lack.
lines.zh: : 而且……言情小说也不{i}只是{/i}性，你知道的。它和别的书一样有故事。只是多了一扇……通往亲密关系的窗，而这是我读的其他故事里缺少的。

lines.en: scene romancenovels16
: {i}The cold air hits my chest as his strong hands, like that of marbled sculptures, unbutton my tunic and lay me out on the grass.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}冰冷的空气拂过我的胸口，他那大理石雕塑般有力的双手解开我的上衣，把我放倒在草地上。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}He shifts my hips and pulls me toward him, his proud length pressing up against me through my undergarments — but when I look into his eyes, the kind, gentle man I have come to know has all but vanished.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}他挪动我的腰，把我拉向他，那根骄傲的大家伙隔着内衣顶在我身上——可当我望进他的眼睛，我所认识的那个温柔善良的男人已经荡然无存。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}In his place lurks a hungry tiger...bursting with bestial vigor and unable to hold himself back from pinning my slender wrists to the ground and taking me as his own.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}取而代之的是一头饥饿的老虎……浑身兽性雄风，再也无法克制自己，把我纤细的手腕按在地面上，将我占为己有。{/i}

lines.en: : Please...stop...I can’t take much more of this...
lines.zh: : 求你……别念了……我受不了了……

lines.en: : {i}He purses his lips and growls, returning his hands to my chest and fondling my breasts before lowering himself down and exploring the rest of me with his tongue.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}他抿起嘴唇，低吼一声，把手放回我的胸口，揉弄我的乳房，然后俯下身，用舌头探索我的其他地方。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}As if it's instinct, I reach for the back of his head, running my fingers through his hair and pressing him further into me as his lips begin to taste the petals of my flower.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}像是出于本能，我伸手摸向他的后脑，手指穿过他的发丝，把他更用力地压向我，而他的唇开始品尝我花朵的花瓣。{/i}

lines.en: : And then they have sex! The end!
lines.zh: : 然后他们就上床了！完！

lines.en: scene romancenovels17
: You’re really enjoying this, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你很享受吧？

lines.en: : I have never felt more embarrassed in my life...and I once stripped for you in the nurse’s office.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子从没这么难为情过……而我曾经还在医务室里为你脱光过。

lines.en: : I remember that. We should do that again sometime.
lines.zh: : 我记得。我们应该什么时候再来一次。

lines.en: : Give my book back and I will let you do whatever you want to me.
lines.zh: : 把书还给我，你想对我做什么都行。

lines.en: : I’ll pass. I’m actually having a lot of fun turning you on like this. It’s not often that {i}you’re{/i} the one overcome with lust while I’m completely unfazed.
lines.zh: : 我拒绝。像这样挑逗你其实挺好玩的。难得有一次是{i}你{/i}被欲望冲昏头，而我完全不为所动。

lines.en: : Unfazed? That didn’t affect you at all?
lines.zh: : 不为所动？那对你一点影响都没有？

lines.en: : Not really. I have no idea who these characters are. Nor do I long for a man to dominate me with bestial vigor.
lines.zh: : 基本没有。我都不知道这些角色是谁。我也不渴望有个男人用兽性雄风来征服我。

lines.en: : There are romance novels written from the male perspective too, you know. And...there’s a good chance I could probably help you find one if you’re ever interested in reading any.
lines.zh: : 也有从男性视角写的言情小说啊。而且……如果你有兴趣读，我很可能还能帮你找到。

lines.en: : That sounds better, but I think sticking to normal sex is probably more my style.
lines.zh: : 听起来好一点，不过我觉得还是正常的性爱比较适合我。

lines.en: scene romancenovels18
: I suppose that’s fair...and here I am, still not even knowing what “normal sex” feels like.
lines.zh: : 大概也是……可我到现在连「正常的性爱」是什么感觉都还不知道。

lines.en: : Is that just horny Futaba speaking? Or is that something I’m supposed to interpret in my own twisted way?
lines.zh: : 这是发情的 Futaba 在说话？还是我该用我自己那套扭曲的方式去理解？

lines.en: : It’s probably...horny Futaba speaking...
lines.zh: : 大概……是发情的 Futaba 在说话吧……

lines.en: : But I also don’t think it would be twisted since...you and I are already...you know...{i}involved.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但我也不觉得那算扭曲，毕竟……你和我早就已经……你知道的……{i}在一起{/i}了。

lines.en: scene romancenovels19
: If only I knew what “bestial vigor” entailed. Maybe then we could be even {i}more{/i} involved.
lines.zh: : 要是我知道「兽性雄风」具体是什么样就好了。那样我们也许能{i}更{/i}亲密。

lines.en: : Sensei...how would you feel if I were to commentate on all of the things {i}you{/i} consume in your free time when you want to...get in the mood?
lines.zh: : Sensei……如果我把{i}你{/i}空闲时间想……进入状态时会看的东西都点评一遍，你会怎么想？

lines.en: : Honestly? Not bad. If anything, I think that might even sound kind of fun.
lines.zh: : 说实话？不错。真要说的话，我觉得那听起来还挺有意思的。

lines.en: scene romancenovels20
: Ugh...it must be so great not getting embarrassed about every little thing.
lines.zh: : 唉……对每件小事都不会难为情，一定很爽吧。

lines.en: : What do you even have to be embarrassed about around me? Do you think I’m suddenly going to stop seeing you just because you read books about elves getting fucked in your free time?
lines.zh: : 你在我面前到底有什么好难为情的？你觉得我会因为你空闲时间看精灵被操的书，就突然不理你了吗？

lines.en: : They’re not even elves. Stop assuming things when you’ve only read one page.
lines.zh: : 那根本不是精灵。你才看了一页就别乱猜了。

lines.en: : Question, then. {i}Have{/i} you read a romance novel about elves getting fucked? Because based on everything I know about you, I have a strong feeling you have.
lines.zh: : 那我问问。你看过精灵被操的言情小说吗？因为根据我对你的了解，我有强烈的预感你看过。

lines.en: scene romancenovels21
: Yes.
lines.zh: : 看过。

lines.en: : I suppose there’s no point in hiding it anymore. You’ve uncovered my biggest secret and my biggest shame.
lines.zh: : 看来再藏着也没意义了。你已经挖出了我最大的秘密、最大的耻辱。

lines.en: : Hey, I’m happy for you. Leaning into your degeneracy isn’t always a {i}bad{/i} thing. Especially when it leads to you learning things about yourself.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我替你高兴。拥抱自己的堕落并不总是{i}坏{/i}事。尤其当它让你更了解自己的时候。

lines.en: : If anything, I feel a little better now knowing that what we have isn’t just a one-sided pursuit of lust on my behalf and that what you really want is a tiger who-
lines.zh: : 要说的话，我现在反而好受些了，因为我知道我们之间不只是一厢情愿的欲望追逐，而你真正想要的是一头会——

lines.en: scene romancenovels22
: I don’t want a {i}tiger,{/i} Sensei...I want you. All of those books are just excuses for me to step into the shoes of somebody else for a little while...
lines.zh: : 我不想要{i}老虎{/i}，Sensei……我想要你。那些书都只是我的借口，好让我能短暂地穿上别人的鞋子……

lines.en: : To experience the connections {i}those{/i} characters have since I doubt I’ll ever be able to do that on my own.
lines.zh: : 去体验{i}那些{/i}角色之间的连结，因为我不确定自己这辈子能不能靠自己做到。

lines.en: : Why not? What makes you so different from all of the elves you’ve watched get fucked?
lines.zh: : 为什么不能？你和那些被操的精灵有什么本质区别？

lines.en: : Stop saying that. The key difference, though, is that all of the characters in all of the books I’ve read know who they are while I’m still mostly...unsure about everything.
lines.zh: : 别再这么说了。不过关键的区别是，我读过的所有书里，所有角色都知道自己是谁，而我大部分时候……对一切都还不确定。

lines.en: : No one in any of the romance novels I’ve read has had an extensive inner monologue about how unworthy of love they are...or how they struggle to look at themselves in the mirror.
lines.zh: : 我读过的任何一本言情小说里，都没有哪个角色长篇大论地独白过自己不配被爱……或者照镜子有多痛苦。

lines.en: : But those are things I think about every day. And even moreso before we get intimate.
lines.zh: : 可这些是我每天都在想的事。在我们上床之前更是想得厉害。

lines.en: scene romancenovels23
: If only there was some sort of way for me to...adopt that perspective. Maybe then, I wouldn’t have to hype myself up just to reciprocate your lust...
lines.zh: : 要是我有办法……换上那种视角就好了。那样我或许就不必为了回应你的欲望而给自己打气……

lines.en: : Or, at the very least, I wouldn’t constantly find myself mentally switching places with a girl being intimate with a strong, mysterious man when I already have one of my own right here who appreciates me for {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 或者至少，我就不会总是发现自己在脑海里，和一个正被强壮神秘的男人疼爱的女孩互换位置——而我身边明明就有一个，为「我」这个本身而珍惜{i}我{/i}的人。

lines.en: : I don’t know if saying this at the height of a personal info dump is a good idea or not, but...maybe try roleplaying? If you can’t get into the right state of mind on your own, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我不知道在这股个人信息倾泻的当口说这个合不合适，不过……也许可以试试角色扮演？我是说，如果你没法自己进入状态的话。

lines.en: scene romancenovels24
: Are you sure that’s even something you’d be okay with?...
lines.zh: : 你确定那样真的可以吗？……

lines.en: : As long as I don’t have to play any sort of role myself. I’m not much of an actor.
lines.zh: : 只要不用我自己演什么角色就行。我不太会演戏。

lines.en: : But if you’re asking if I’d be okay “getting intimate” with you while {i}you’re{/i} putting on some sort of show, absolutely.
lines.zh: : 但如果{i}你{/i}问的是，在你演点什么的时候我愿不愿意和你「亲密」，当然愿意。

lines.en: : I think you should do whatever it is that makes you comfortable and it’s not really my duty to tell you if what you’re doing is okay or not.
